sentences.text: He had no access to the locker.
He is willing to cooperate with the investigation.

2. Learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State submitted that the case should have been registered under Section 409 and not under Section 406.
3.

However, having regard to the fact that the case now has been registered under Section 406, the court may decide whether any opportunity should be given to the petitioner to comply with the notice under Section 41A.
